device: Oral-B (4 sectors; the advertisement carries no model)
note: A second four-sector Oral-B, brushed at the same time as the other one, received badly: 10 advertisements for a 168 s session, gaps up to 51 s. Kept because it confirms the 1, 2, 3, 7 sequence on a different physical handle, and because a stream this sparse is itself a case worth having - a brush two rooms away looks like this. Too thin to replay a routine from; the zone changes are inferred from the timer, not observed. Captured from a handle that is no longer reachable, so this recording cannot be repeated.
